articles.title: A One-Minute Cancer Jab? NHS Patients Get More Time to Garden!
articles.summary: A new injection for the cancer drug Keytruda takes just one minute instead of an hour. Shirley Xerxes, 86, says it gives her more time for gardening. About 14,000 patients in England could switch to the jab.

articles.title: AI Super-Sleuth Finds 100+ Hidden Planets, Including a World That Orbits in Just One Day!
articles.summary: A smart computer program called RAVEN found over 100 new planets in NASA data. Some orbit their stars in under 24 hours. The discovery helps scientists understand how common planets are around stars like our Sun.

articles.title: Is Time a Tiny Bit Blurry? Physicists Find a Flaw in the Universe's Clock!
articles.summary: Scientists studying quantum mechanics think time might have a tiny built-in fuzziness. This comes from ideas about how gravity might affect tiny particles. Don't worry—your watch is perfectly fine! Even the best atomic clocks can't notice it.
